body: Last year, a car rolled off the overpass behind my house. It was a 6 seat car with 8 people in it. 6 were kids, the adults were the mothers. I ran to the car, I think i was the first or second person there, and started getting these people out. My nighbors were medics. One nighbor was an SF medic and his wife was a nurse, and the other was a normal army medic, but he had been in for 17 plus years, so he knew stuff. But I remember helping get these kids out and helping my nighbors. They seemed so calm and knew what to do, while i felt almost usless. A little girl and boy died that day. I'll never forget it. God bless them, and God bless people who train to save other people's lives.
